goal: Add a StaminaComponent node script (scripts/components/stamina.gd) with class_name StaminaComponent: exported max_stamina float, regen_per_second float, a spend(amount: float) -> bool that fails when insufficient, a changed(current: float, maximum: float) signal, regen in _process. Add a gdUnit4 test.
acceptance: spend returns false when stamina is insufficient
a test in tests/ covers spend and regen

goal: Create a DayNightClock autoload (scripts/day_night_clock.gd) that runs a 12 minute day and 6 minute night, exposes is_night: bool and progress: float (0-1 within the phase), and emits phase_changed(is_night: bool). Register it in project.godot.
acceptance: a gdUnit4 test advances time via a public tick(delta) method

goal: Add a data-driven item table: game/data/items.json with three scavenge items (scrap, cable, lamp oil) and scripts/items.gd (class_name Items) that loads it in _ready and exposes get_item(id: String) -> Dictionary. No hardcoded item data in code.
acceptance: items.json has three entries with id, name, weight
a test checks a known id and an unknown id

goal: Create scenes/player/player.tscn with a CharacterBody2D root, a Sprite2D placeholder (ColorRect named PlaceholderSprite is fine) and scripts/player.gd: 8-direction movement using move_and_slide, exported speed, input actions move_left/right/up/down added to project.godot.

Add a flow-field helper scripts/ai/flow_field.gd (class_name FlowField) that takes a grid size, a set of blocked cells and a target cell, computes integer distances with a BFS, and exposes direction_at(cell: Vector2i) -> Vector2i pointing to the lowest neighbour.
acceptance: BFS is correct on a 5x5 grid with one wall
direction_at returns Vector2i.ZERO at the target

goal: Add a server-authoritative HealthComponent (scripts/components/health.gd, class_name HealthComponent) with exported max_health, take_damage(amount: int) that only applies when multiplayer.is_server() or when running without a peer, a died signal, and an is_dead() query.
acceptance: a test covers damage to zero and no double death

goal: Add a Roofs fade behaviour: scripts/roof_fader.gd attached to a TileMapLayer named Roofs; when a node in group 'player' overlaps an Area2D child named Footprint, tween the layer modulate alpha to 0.2 over 0.25 s, and back to 1.0 on exit. Build a small test scene scenes/levels/roof_test.tscn.

Create a WaveDirector (scripts/night/wave_director.gd, class_name WaveDirector) that, given a night index, returns a wave plan: 5 waves, thrall counts scaling 20 + 10*night, one Courser per wave from night 2, a Herald on wave 5 from night 3, capped at 150 enemies per wave. Pure data, no scene.
